mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) may potentiate immunosuppressive effects of triamcinolone and increase GI ulceration risk through additive anti-inflammatory mechanisms and potential CYP3A4 inhibition affecting steroid metabolism.
action: Monitor for increased steroid side effects (GI upset, immunosuppression); separate dosing by 2+ hours and consider GI protection; counsel patient on concurrent use risks.
